name: The verb
definition: A word that shows a meaning in itself together with one of the three times: past, present or future.
body: نَصَرَ (he helped) gives an act and a past time; يَنْصُرُ (he helps, he will help) the act in the present or the future; اُنْصُرْ (help!) a command for the time to come.
Al-Ājurrūmiyya gives the verb its signs: qad before it (قَدْ نَصَرَ), the sīn and sawfa of the future (سَيَنْصُرُ), and the tāʾ of the feminine with sukūn (نَصَرَتْ).

examples.text: qad naṣara, he has helped: qad marks a verb.
sa-yanṣuru, he will help: sa- marks a verb.
